column1: # ATLASea theme: one color per eukaryotic phylum commonly met in ATLASea samples,
# plus Dinophyceae and Phaeophyceae, which have no phylum in the NCBI taxonomy.
# Every superkingdom keeps its default color, so eukaryotes outside the listed
# taxa stay red. Colors were picked to be as
# far apart as possible in the CAM02-UCS color space, the most distinct ones
